kite.title: Kite Lessons
kite.subtitle: Master the wind with our professional instructors! Learn kitesurfing with the best instructors in Watamu. All levels welcome!
kite.desc8h: The complete course to become an autonomous kitesurfer! Includes theory, body drag, water start and first rides.
kite.desc6h: Intermediate course perfect for those who want to consolidate basics and improve technique.
kite.desc3h: Introduction to the world of kiting. Learn safety basics and kite control.
kite.desc1h: Single session for refreshing or perfecting specific techniques.

rentals.title: Rentals
rentals.subtitle: Kites, paddle boards and motorbikes to explore Watamu in total freedom!
rentals.kiteRentalDesc1h: Complete kite equipment rental for experienced riders. Kite, bar and board included.
rentals.kiteRentalDescDay: Full day of kiting! Take advantage of different conditions throughout the day.
rentals.paddleDesc1h: Explore the calm waters of Watamu on a paddle board. Perfect for relaxing!
rentals.paddleDescTour: Guided tour in the Watamu creek. Discover nature and mangroves from a paddle board.
rentals.motoDescMonth: Maximum freedom to explore the Kenyan coast. The best way to get around!
rentals.motoDesc2Weeks: Two weeks of exploration with your personal motorcycle.
rentals.motoDescWeek: Short rental for day trips or adventure weeks.

photos.title: Kite Photography
photos.subtitle: Capture the action! Professional photos of your kite sessions for unforgettable memories.
photos.desc5: Capture your best moments on the kite! 5 professional high-resolution photos.
photos.desc10: The complete package! 10 professional photos to immortalize your session.

safari.title: Safari excursions
safari.subtitle: Experience the magic of Kenya’s wildlife with carefully crafted safari packages designed for every traveler — from quick escapes to once-in-a-lifetime luxury adventures. At KITE & BIKE TOURS AND ADVENTURE, we combine authentic experiences, professional guides, and great value to give you unforgettable memories.
safari.desc1: Ideal for travelers with a tight schedule. Enjoy a full day of wildlife viewing with: comfortable transport, professional safari guide, park entry fees and exciting game drives close to Nairobi.
safari.desc2: A great value option to explore Kenya’s iconic parks while sharing costs with fellow travelers. Shared safari vehicle Budget-friendly lodges or camps, multiple game drives, meals and park fees included.
safari.desc3: Perfect for adventurous travelers who want great experiences at a lower cost. Shared vehicle Basic but clean lodges or camps Guided game drives Excellent wildlife sightings
safari.desc4: Our most popular option — comfort, value, and unforgettable moments. Well-rated lodges and tented camps All transport, meals & park fees included Experienced driver-guides More time inside the parks
safari.desc5: For travelers seeking exclusivity and elegance. High-end lodges and luxury tented camps Private safari vehicles & guides Optional internal flights Personalized, stress-free experience
safari.desc6: Explore multiple parks and cultural highlights at a relaxed pace. Customized itineraries Top-tier accommodation

marafa.title: Hell's Kitchen (Marafa)
marafa.description: Visit the stunning sandstone formations of Marafa and witness breathtaking sunset views! A natural wonder located just a short drive from Watamu, with unique geological formations shaped over millions of years.
marafa.longDescription: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure to Marafa, also known as Hell's Kitchen! Our expert guides will take you on a thrilling journey to this natural wonder. Hike through the stunning rock formations, explore the unique geological formations and learn about the history and culture of the area.

safariBlue.title: Safari Blue Experience
safariBlue.description: Full-day adventure on a glass boat with snorkeling, island hopping, seafood lunch and dolphin watching! The ultimate marine experience in Watamu.
safariBlue.longDescription: Dive into the ultimate adventure! A full day on a glass-bottom boat to admire marine life, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, island hopping among paradise islands and fresh fish lunch. Don't miss the dolphin watching!

gede.title: Gede Ruins Tour
gede.description: Discover ancient Swahili history in a guided forest tour. Explore the mysterious ruins of a 12th century Swahili town hidden in the forest.
gede.longDescription: A journey through time! Discover the mysterious ruins of Gede, an ancient 12th century Swahili town abandoned and now a historical heritage. Our expert guide will tell you the fascinating story of this unique place.

sardinia2.title: Sardinia 2 Island
sardinia2.description: Half day trip to the beautiful Sardinia 2 island with snorkeling, fruits and refreshments. A perfect morning or afternoon escape!
sardinia2.longDescription: Half day of paradise! Reach Sardinia 2 island to enjoy crystal-clear waters, snorkeling among colorful fish, fresh fruit and refreshing drinks. The perfect way to relax!

loveIsland.title: Love Island
loveIsland.description: A romantic escape to Love Island with boat ride, fruits and refreshments. Perfect for couples or a relaxing day out!
loveIsland.longDescription: The island of love awaits you! A romantic and relaxing experience with boat trip, fresh fruit and drinks. Ideal for couples or those seeking absolute tranquility.

sunset.title: Sunset Viewing Experience
sunset.description: Watch the magical sunset from Crab Shack with canoe ride through mangroves, drinks and delicious crab samosa!
sunset.longDescription: Kenya's most beautiful sunset! Canoe trip through the mangroves to Crab Shack to enjoy a cocktail, beer and delicious crab samosas while the sun sets over the ocean.

culture.title: African Culture Experience
culture.description: Immerse yourself in authentic African culture! Visit local villages, learn traditions and experience the real Kenya.
culture.longDescription: An authentic immersion in African culture! Visit local villages, discover ancestral traditions, meet local people and experience the real Kenya away from tourist circuits.

0.question: How can I book an activity?
0.answer: You can book directly from the website by clicking 'Book Now' on any activity, or by contacting us via WhatsApp. We'll respond within a few hours with availability and confirmation.

1.question: What payment methods do you accept?
1.answer: We accept cash payment (Euros, Dollars, Kenyan Shillings), M-Pesa and bank transfer. Some activities require a deposit to confirm the booking.

2.question: Can I cancel a booking?
2.answer: Yes, we offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before the activity. For last-minute cancellations, contact us and we'll find a solution.

3.question: Do you provide equipment for activities?
3.answer: Yes! All activities include the necessary equipment. For kite lessons, we provide kite, bar, harness and board. For snorkeling, mask and fins.

4.question: Are you available year-round?
4.answer: We operate year-round! The best conditions for kiting are from June to March. For tours, every season has its charm.
